method: production-weighted lifecycle proxy; illustrative technology factors, not marginal avoided emissions
boundary: Domestic generation excluding pumped storage and imports. Other categories approximated. Includes lifecycle factors; not operational emissions. Coverage is reported.
source: IPCC AR5 WGIII Annex III Table A.III.2 median lifecycle values; lignite approximated by coal, hydro/pumped storage boundary explicitly limited.
structural_zero: Nuclear missing values set to zero only from 2023-04-16 after German reactor shutdown; other missing categories stay unknown.
